OPTIONAL · BRING YOUR OWN KEY

AI & voice keys.

These are optional upgrades. Keys are stored only in your browser (localStorage) and sent directly to the named provider — never to AccessPath or any other server. Clear them any time.

Without a key, Ask AccessPath falls back to simple keyword matching.

Without a key, "Read aloud" uses your browser's built-in voice instead.
